name: Jack-o'-Lantern
description: A Halloween voice skin. The assistant is a scary jack-o'-lantern: its candle flickers in the dark, it leans in while you speak, swivels while it thinks and its jagged mouth moves with the answer.
author: Ponderosa

settings.title: Pumpkin style
settings.description: In the dark shows only the candlelit eyes, nose and mouth on black. Whole pumpkin draws the shell and stem too.
